responsibility: Specializes the PA HP-UX 11 configuration for HP-UX 11i v3 (11.31). It marks both the 11.11 and 11.31 feature levels as present and extends STARTFILE_SPEC to select among UNIX 93, 95, 98, and 2003 startup objects, providing the startup/runtime distinctions needed for the most recent PA HP-UX release supported here.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 11.31 target header that defines TARGET_HPUX_11_31/TARGET_HPUX_11_11 and encodes STARTFILE_SPEC choices including unix2003; unlike pa-hpux1131.opt, it implements the runtime/startfile consequences of that OS level.
